//: The village's road network, extracted from OpenStreetMap.
© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Bundled rather than fetched so the
streets are drawn by this app on top of whichever basemap is showing —
on the satellite view especially, where a road network is exactly what
aerial imagery does not give you.
'name' is present on precisely one way. That is not an extraction bug:
OpenStreetMap records 82 ways here and names one of them, the
Vilia-Porto Germeno road. The streets inside the settlement have no
names in OSM, in Nominatim, or in any public source checked. They are
drawn unlabelled rather than labelled with invented names.
